raw_segments.text: Mama, poor crippled darling, Elisha has sent you these flowers," he cried, holding out
to her a little bunch of flowers that had been frozen and broken while he was struggling
But at that instant he saw in the corner, by the little bed, Elisha's little boots,
which the landlady had put tidily side by side.
Seeing the old, patched, rusty-looking, stiff boots he flung up his hands and rushed to
them, fell on his knees, snatched up one boot and pressing his lips to it, began kissing
Elisha, old man, dear old man, wear your little feet.
